_note: Use cases from the discovery workshop (docs/08-workshops-and-training/discovery-workshop.md), scored 1–5 by the room. Weights are agreed at the start of the workshop. Read by src/prioritise.mjs; the table in docs/08-workshops-and-training/prioritisation.md is generated from this file.

criteria.value: hours saved, faster answers, fewer complaints — 5 = large and measurable
criteria.feasibility: data available, API exists, rules can be written down, the team can run it — 5 = can start next week
criteria.risk: harm if it goes wrong: data to the wrong person, money, relationship — 5 = low risk

useCases.name: Status replies from the TMS
useCases.note: 38% of the mailbox; API exists; risk is data to the wrong person, handled by authorisation per shipment

useCases.name: Proof-of-delivery retrieval
useCases.note: 11% of the mailbox; a POD carries a signature, so registered contacts only

useCases.name: Triage of the whole mailbox to queues
useCases.note: comes free with the reading step; misrouting costs minutes, not trust

useCases.name: Slot changes
useCases.note: needs planning rules written down and a write API

useCases.name: Claims intake (form + photos)
useCases.note: money and relationships; with the claims team, after phase 1

useCases.name: Generative free-text replies
useCases.note: every sentence must be approved once; see ADR-003

useCases.name: 'Chat with the TMS' for agents in Teams
useCases.note: nice, but the email still has to be answered by hand

useCases.name: Invoice copies on request
useCases.note: low volume (4%); Business Central already has a portal
